stories.title: Druski hosts SNL and turns himself into Elizabeth Holmes
stories.summary: Druski, the first content creator to host SNL, joked he couldn't promise "no whiteface," then appeared as Elizabeth Holmes in prosthetics, a blonde wig and blue contacts. The audience screamed, and X argued about the whiteface all weekend.

stories.title: Druski as Elizabeth Holmes in SNL's "Dru Can See Everything"
stories.summary: In a parody of Nathan Fielder's Holmes documentary, Druski wore prosthetics, a blonde wig and blue contacts for a "Holmes-off" with Jane Wickline.
